name: permission-scope
body: The per-path scope under which an agent's write (edit or filesystem operation) is permitted: the set of glob patterns granted to that agent, resolved in one frame with the path being written. For a CODE-WRITER the scope is WORKTREE-ROOTED — its globs name `apg/.worktrees/*/<glob>` paths only, never a main-checkout path — so the grant covers exactly the project worktree the agent mutates and main stays read-only to it. The only scopes that reach the main checkout belong to the carve-outs of `global.constraint.worktree-isolation` (the agent-builder's `.opencode/agents/**`; the optional release-agent's per-repo release artefacts). It is the agent's owned surface expressed for path matching — narrow by construction (deny-by-default, exactly the source/config/test globs the role owns), never a blanket capability. A path outside the scope is refused.
